==Description==
'''Recliner''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Frost Invasion Event#Frost Invasion Season Pass|Frost Invasion Season]]. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote, though eating and drinking sound effects can be heard. You are unable to move while performing this emote.

This emote was obtainable at Rank 11 in regards to the Event Season Pass, which would cost {{Shards|850 Shards}} or {{Robux|500}} at that rank. The total cost to get from Rank 1 to Rank 11 was {{Shards|5,325 Shards}} or {{Robux|2,600}}.

==Trivia==
*'''Recliner''' is functionally and visually similar to the [[Lazy Couch]] and [[Sun Bathing]] emote, which could be obtained during the [[Christmas 2019 Event]] and via the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]].
**This emote is also similar to the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Pooped_Deck Pooped Deck] taunt from ''Team Fortress 2''.
*The sound of eating hamburger is a reference to [[w:c:plantsvszombies:Chomper (PvZ)|Chomper]] from ''Plants vs. Zombies''.
*This emote, along with the [[Lazy Couch]], [[Firework]], [[Frozen (Emote)|Frozen]], [[Raw Dinner]] and [[Axe Throw]] emotes, are the only emotes to play global sounds.
*The recliner in the emote will be floating off the ground if the player uses the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/79/Levitation-Animation-Pack Levitation Animation Pack] idle.
